edge_risk_combinatorics.explanation: The aligned count requires at least one shared row (horizontal neighbours) or column (vertical neighbours) where both opposing edge bits are active. The later-painted cell can overwrite the earlier cell there when colours differ.

raster.ownership_invariant: Raster footprints emitted by two distinct terminal cells must not occupy the same device pixel; otherwise paint order can replace the earlier cell's colour/depth result.
